name: Open a Solution
description: Finds every solution under Projects, lets you pick one, and opens it with whatever Windows associates with it.

actions.comment: *.sln* rather than *.sln: .slnx is the current format and .slnf is a solution filter, and a pattern that matches only the oldest of the three finds nothing in a modern repository. Depth 3 catches src/ and nested layouts without walking the whole tree.

then.reason: No solutions under the Projects directory.

actions.comment: The specific IDE does not matter here, so let the shell decide rather than hardcoding one.
